0.original: Vuyargur has his heart set on carts.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

2.original: Deliver the requested items to Vuyargur.

48.original: Since our work commenced, we have been needing to transport large amounts of supplies to Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

49.original: While we have simple, sturdy carts for this purpose, there is presently not enough to meet demand. I wish to build more, and ask that you furnish us with some necessary parts.

50.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, might I trouble you to furnish us with cart components again?

51.original: The conveyances assembled using your parts are highly favored for their maneuverability, and I have a mind to build more.

52.original: Garharlor yonder has the materials you require, so please present yourself to him. My thanks in advance.

53.original: You are helping us build carts? Good, good, quality components are always welcome.

54.original: Without further ado, then, please use these materials to prepare parts for the underframe. If you run out, I shall provide you with more.

55.original: Without further ado, then, please use these materials to prepare parts for the dampener. If you run out, I shall provide you with more.

56.original: Without further ado, then, please use these materials to prepare parts for the axle. If you run out, I shall provide you with more.

57.original: When the items are ready, you may deliver them directly to Vuyargur. I wish you happy crafting.

58.original: Do you require more materials? You need but say the word if so.

61.original: You require more materials? Here, please use these.

64.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. How are the cart components coming along?

65.original: Sturdy <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> light... At scarcely more than a glance, you were able to identify a point for improvement. You truly are an extraordinary artisan.

66.original: You spare no effort, and it shows in the finish. I receive these with thanks.

67.original: We Yok Huy traditionally build with stone and wood, and typically prioritize strength at the cost of weight.

68.original: Given the mountainous terrain in which the carts will be used, however, it would be wise to keep weight to a limit. Your components help us to achieve that, and I shall enjoy assembling the final product with them.
